"His name was Wernher von Braun, and the two gases that he released from his particular version of a thermos flask—the one lying on its side behind me now—were hydrogen and oxygen. 

If you release those two gases into a confined space with a hole at the other end of it and mix them as you do so and then set light to them, you get that."
